extensionDescription.message: A local LLM translates pages on your device. Free, no account.

tagline.message: Page translation that runs on your device

gestureLongPressNote.message: With nothing selected, it opens the translator for the text you are writing.

gestureBar.message: Bilingual button in the progress bar

diagRateHint.message: While a page is translating, its bar shows tokens/s and segments/s.

diagGpuHelp.message: This report stays on this device. If WebGPU failed, paste it into a GitHub issue.

paceHelp.message: Translates paragraphs just before they scroll into view. "Look ahead further" prefetches more below the fold, so the text is ready when you scroll. For the languages PLaMo supports, every line comes from PLaMo; Chrome's draft is never used.

paceHelpFirefox.message: Translates paragraphs just before they scroll into view. "Look ahead further" prefetches more below the fold, so the text is ready when you scroll. Every line comes from PLaMo.

unofficialNotice.message: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Preferred Networks. Built with PLaMo.

optionsLead.message: Choose how translation works, manage the model, and set per-site behavior. Changes save automatically.

privacyBody.message: This extension does not send page text to a server. There is no telemetry.

privacyDestinations.message: The extension's own request is the model download. It starts at huggingface.co and follows Hugging Face's redirect to its CDN. Page text is not included. Chrome downloads its language packs itself.

privacyDestinationsFirefox.message: The extension's own request is the model download. It starts at huggingface.co and follows Hugging Face's redirect to its CDN. Page text is not included.

licensesBody.message: The full PLaMo Community License and this extension's MIT license are bundled with the extension.

licenseModelNote.message: The model weights are not bundled. They are downloaded from the official Hugging Face repository when they are not already stored on this device.

machineTranslationNotice.message: Translations are machine translations produced by PLaMo.

onboardingLead.message: Page translation runs on your device. The PLaMo 3 model downloads only when it is not already stored on this device.

onboardingModelNote.message: The default model (573 MB) downloads to this device. A sustained 100 Mbps transfer of that size is about 46 seconds before overhead; real time varies. An interrupted download resumes.

onboardingBridgeNote.message: The page keeps its original text until the model is ready, then PLaMo translates it. Google documents Chrome's translation as on-device.

onboardingBridgeNoteFirefox.message: The page keeps its original text until the model is ready, then PLaMo translates it.

onboardingPrivacyNote.message: This extension does not send page text to a server.

engineFirefoxSingleThread.message: Firefox extension pages cannot use wasm threads, so CPU translation uses one thread.

tierGpuMobileWarning.message: WebGPU on phone GPUs can produce wrong translations. If the text comes out garbled, Sakutto switches back to the CPU by itself.

fabEverywhereSetting.message: Show the translate button on every site

fabEverywhereSettingHelp.message: The button needs access to all sites, which is asked for once. Sites set to never translate are skipped.

fabEverywhereGrant.message: Allow the translate button on all sites

fabEverywhereGrantFailed.message: Site access was not granted. The button appears only on pages where you open Sakutto.

gpuHarnessHelp.message: Runs a fixed paragraph through the CPU and WebGPU backends and compares the outputs. A sideloaded install keeps its own model copy, so download the 0.8B model here first.

tierAdrenoAutoHelp.message: On Qualcomm Adreno GPUs, Automatic uses WebGPU with the Adreno profile below (on a test phone about 2.3 s per paragraph vs 2.9 s on the CPU). If the GPU produces garbled text, Automatic moves to the CPU on this device; choose GPU (WebGPU) to try it again. Models marked GPU experimental (Qwen3, Gemma 3) run on the CPU under Automatic.

gpuProfileOptimizedHelp.message: Round-6 kernels: the new q4_K mat-vec (16-byte loads, 4 rows per group) + fused gate/up with SwiGLU + fused norm chain, 2 parallel slots. Fastest on the test phone (POCO F5 Pro): about 2.25 s per paragraph (CPU about 2.9 s). Use this unless something goes wrong.

gpuProfileCompatHelp.message: Without the round-6 kernels: batched mat-vec + 128-wide softmax (the 1.3.0 development setup), about 2.7 s per paragraph on the test phone. Use it if the new kernels misbehave on your device.

gpuProfileInactive.message: The profile applies only when the GPU is used (Automatic on Adreno, or GPU (WebGPU)).

gpuProfileQ4v2Help.message: Only the new q4_K mat-vec (4 rows per group), without op fusion. About 2.29 s per paragraph on the test phone, almost as fast as Optimized. Try this first if Optimized gives wrong text or stops responding.

gpuProfileR6Help.message: The new q4_K kernel with 2 rows per group, plus both op fusions. Lower register pressure, for older or smaller Adreno GPUs; about 2.5 s per paragraph on the test phone.

gpuProfileLowMemoryHelp.message: The same kernels as Optimized with a single parallel slot (n_ctx 1024), halving the KV cache. Recommended for models over 1 GB (Qwen3 1.7B, Hy-MT2, PLaMo 2B) or phones with less RAM; one paragraph is about as fast, several at once are a little slower.

gpuProfileR4Help.message: The most conservative GPU setup: none of the round-5/6 mat-vec changes, tiled matmul for prompts and 256-wide softmax. Slowest (about 3.8 s per paragraph on the test phone); only use it if every other profile fails.

gpuProfileExperimentalAuto.message: The current model is marked GPU experimental, so Automatic runs it on the CPU on Adreno; the profile only applies when you choose GPU (WebGPU) yourself.

modelGpuExperimentalHelp.message: Results on Adreno GPUs can differ from the CPU; Automatic runs it on the CPU. Choose GPU (WebGPU) yourself to test it on the GPU.

modelLargeMobileWarning.message: Over 1 GB: on a phone this model runs on the CPU, also when WebGPU is selected (WebGPU memory comes out of the same RAM as the page, and these models closed it while loading). It loads with 1 slot, n_ctx 1024 and batch 128; downloading and loading are slower. If the engine still closes while it loads, Sakutto goes back to PLaMo 3 0.8B.
modelLargeMobileWarning.description: Model list: a model over 1 GB on Edge for Android (runs on the CPU there).

modelGemmaTerms.message: Downloading and using Gemma means you agree to the Gemma Terms of Use and its Prohibited Use Policy.

modelDescQwen3Small.message: The smallest and fastest general model. Average translation quality; for speed or low-end phones.

modelDescPlamoSmall.message: Translation model (default). Natural Japanese, English and Chinese; supports the glossary and Japanese polite/plain style.

modelDescGemma.message: Google's general instruction model with balanced multilingual ability.

modelDescQwen3Large.message: The larger Qwen3. Clearly better Chinese and English than 0.6B, about half the speed.

modelDescHyMt.message: Tencent Hunyuan translation model: 33 languages in any direction, high quality.

modelDescPlamoLarge.message: The high-quality PLaMo translation model. The largest file and the heaviest on phone memory.

modelLoadCrashed.message: The last time this model loaded on this phone (on the CPU), Edge closed the translation engine (out of memory), so Sakutto went back to PLaMo 3 0.8B. You can choose Use again; if it closes again, Sakutto goes back again.
modelLoadCrashed.description: Model list: the last CPU load of this model closed the engine on this phone.

modelLoadCrashedGpu.message: The last time this model loaded on WebGPU on this phone, Edge closed the translation engine (out of memory). It now runs on the CPU. Choose WebGPU again in the engine settings to retry the GPU.
modelLoadCrashedGpu.description: Model list: the last WebGPU load of this model closed the engine on this phone; it now runs on the CPU.

tierLargeModelCpuMobile.message: The current model is over 1 GB: on a phone it runs on the CPU even with WebGPU selected. GPU memory is shared with the page, and loading these models on WebGPU closed it. PLaMo 3 0.8B and the smaller models still use WebGPU.
tierLargeModelCpuMobile.description: Engine settings, Edge for Android: the active model is over 1 GB and runs on the CPU.
